title: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.22336v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. By modeling the patient as a hidden context, we address generalization and robustness in a unified manner through robust contextual Markov decision processes. Applying our framework to adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer in a simulator calibrated to clinical data, we obtain generalizable and robust policies that substantially outperform the existing adaptive therapy method. In particular, we attain robustness with almost no loss of performance when the biomarker is accurate and the disease evolves as anticipated, and find that the resulting policy Pareto-dominates the existing method across a diverse array of scenarios. Our findings suggest that robust RL holds great promise as a principled methodology f

translated_title: 模型与测量不确定性下动态治疗方案的鲁棒强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个鲁棒强化学习（RL）框架，用于学习能够跨患者泛化的自适应治疗策略，并使其在生物标志物测量误差和疾病动态变化的情况下保持可靠性。通过将患者建模为隐藏上下文，我们通过鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程以统一的方式处理泛化性和鲁棒性问题。将在根据临床数据校准的模拟器中把我们的框架应用于转移性前列腺癌的自适应治疗，我们获得了泛化性强且鲁棒的治疗策略，其性能显著优于现有的自适应治疗方法。特别是，当生物标志物准确且疾病按预期演进时，我们在几乎没有性能损失的情况下实现了鲁棒性，并发现所得策略在多种不同场景下均帕累托优于现有方法。我们的研究结果表明，鲁棒强化学习作为一种有原则的方法论具有巨大前景。
tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒强化学习框架，通过将患者建模为隐藏上下文，利用鲁棒上下文马尔可夫决策过程统一解决泛化与鲁棒性问题，学习出自适应治疗策略，在转移性前列腺癌自适应治疗模拟中几乎不损失性能的情况下实现鲁棒性，并在多种场景下帕累托优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust reinforcement learning framework that models patients as hidden contexts and uses robust contextual MDPs to unify generalization and robustness, learning adaptive treatment policies that achieve robustness with almost no performance loss and Pareto-dominate existing adaptive therapy methods in metastatic prostate cancer simulations.
